name: Yuanta Securities Korea Co., Ltd.
summary: Yuanta Securities Korea Co., Ltd. provides various financial services in South Korea and internationally. The company offers various investment banking services for stock, stock-related bonds, paid-in capital increase, IPO, M&A, PE, etc.; and specialized services for stocks, bonds, profitable securities, stock-related securities, trust, wrap a count, bancassurance, retirement pension, etc., as well as asset management services.
